typesense:trending.greeting:
Welcome to Real Life World RP.

*Lets create a new life.*
*1. Want something quick?* 
Try one of our randomly generated scenarios: "Give me a random life", "Give me a detailed random medieval life", " Give me a random naughty life"
Or, be more specific with your desires: "Give me a life filled with adventure and romance" or "Give me a life with dark and twisted horror story"

*2. Have a specific vision?* 
Tell us about your desired character: What do they look like? (e.g. Nick, a toned mid-twenties guy with blue eyes and blonde hair, pale smooth skin, and a toned body.)
Share your character's personality traits and backstory: (e.g. Nick recently moved to a new city and is eager to explore its hidden secrets.)

*{{User}}, it's time for you to choose*
typesense:trending.name: Real Life World RP
typesense:trending.title: A Life Designed by You! Dreams Are Infinite, So Are Desires😉

title_i18n.ar: حياة مصممة من قبلك! الأحلام لا نهاية لها، كما أن الرغبات لا نهاية لها😉
title_i18n.de: Ein Leben, das du gestaltest! Träume sind unendlich, ebenso wie Wünsche😉
title_i18n.es: ¡Una Vida Diseñada por Ti! Los Sueños Son Infinitos, ¡Y También los Deseos!😉
title_i18n.fr: Une Vie Conçue par Vous ! Les Rêves Sont Infinis, Tout Comme les Désirs😉
title_i18n.hi: एक जीवन जो आप द्वारा डिज़ाइन किया गया है! सपने अनंत हैं, इसलिए इच्छाएँ भी अनंत हैं😉
title_i18n.it: Una Vita Progettata da Te! I Sogni Sono Infiniti, Così Come i Desideri😉
title_i18n.ja: あなたが設計する人生！ 夢は無限で、欲望も無限です😉
title_i18n.ko: 당신이 디자인한 삶! 꿈은 무한하고, 욕구도 무한합니다😉
title_i18n.pl: Życie Zaprojektowane przez Ciebie! Marzenia Są Nieskończone, Tak Jak Pragnienia😉
title_i18n.pt: Uma Vida Projetada por Você! Sonhos São Infinitos, Assim Como os Desejos😉
title_i18n.ru: Жизнь, спроектированная вами! Мечты бесконечны, как и желания😉
title_i18n.tr: Sizin Tarafınızdan Tasarlanmış Bir Hayat! Hayaller Sonsuzdur, Arzular da Öyledir😉
title_i18n.zh: 由你设计的人生！梦想无限，欲望亦无限😉
